answer: Reputation Decay Curve. Each identity accrues standing only through successful interactions, but standing decays on a fixed half-life, so dormant or fresh identities hold trivial weight. An attacker building N credible identities must pay to sustain all of them simultaneously against the tide of decay, not fund them once. Cost scales linearly with identity count times half-life, and lost standing is unrecoverable ivory. The ocean of cheap throwaway accounts gains no traction.
